narr: The center of the remnants of Hurricane Ida moved well west and north of the region. However, a trailing band of showers and thunderstorms brought gusty winds to the area with a few reports of wind damage and flooding.
ev: A spotter reported water covering portions of Highway 98 with water depth up to the hubcaps on cars. Water was also approaching some businesses in Parker along Highway 98.
lsr: SPOTTER REPORTS WATER COVERING PORTIONS OF US-98 WITH WATER DEPTH UP TO HUBCAPS ON CARS. WATER APPROACHING SOME BUSINESSES IN PARKER ALONG US-98.
